from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,re,hashlib,subprocess
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'governance/compat'))
from build_dispatch_packet_scaffold import ScaffoldArgs
import build_worker_return_skeleton_scaffold as dispatch
import run_worker_return_scaffold as standalone
import check_work_order_acceptance_ledger as ledger
import check_review_cost_control as readiness
import check_worker_experience_retrospective as retro

artifact='docs/reviews/local_wrs_independent_sample.md'
requirement={'requirementId':'LOCAL-R73','mandatory':True,'expectedArtifacts':[artifact],'requiredProofIds':['LOCAL-P81']}
wo='## Work-Order Acceptance Requirement Ledger\n```acceptance-ledger-json\n'+json.dumps({'schemaVersion':ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,'requirements':[requirement],'proofCatalog':[{'proofId':'LOCAL-P81','kind':'COMMAND','locator':'Local independently assembled sample'}]})+'\n```\n'
row={'requirementId':'LOCAL-R73','actualArtifacts':[artifact],'proofRefs':['LOCAL-P81'],'status':'PASS'}
head=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
cases=[]
def record(name,issues,clean):
    cases.append({'caseId':name,'expectedClean':clean,'actualClean':not issues,'issues':list(issues),'expectationMatched':(not issues)==clean})
def setfield(text,field,value):
    result,n=re.subn(r'(?m)^'+re.escape(field)+r':.*$',field+': '+value,text,count=1)
    assert n==1,field
    return result
def completed(raw):
    text=setfield(raw,'Status','COMPLETE_PENDING_REVIEW')
    envelope={'schemaVersion':ledger.EVIDENCE_SCHEMA,'executionBaseHead':head,'results':[row]}
    text,n=re.subn(r'```acceptance-evidence-json\n.*?\n```','```acceptance-evidence-json\n'+json.dumps(envelope)+'\n```',text,count=1,flags=re.S);assert n==1
    for field,value in {'rootCauseClusterId':'LOCAL-WRS-R73','consolidatedDefectClassSweep':'COMPLETE_ALL_KNOWN_DEPENDENCIES','productionBindingEvidence':'LOCAL_INDEPENDENT_GENERATED_TEXT_CONSUMER_PROBE','adversarialRegressionDisposition':'PASS_TARGETED_DEFECT_CLASS','terminalReadinessVerdict':'READY_FOR_REVIEW','frictionLevel':'LOW','frictionType':'KEYWORD_TRAP','observedStep':'Local isolated token and consumer verification','preventiveControlCandidate':'WORK_ORDER_TEMPLATE'}.items():text=setfield(text,field,value)
    return text
def build(batch,profile):
    args=ScaffoldArgs(packet_kind='generic-worker-dispatch',batch_id=batch,title='Local isolated review',date='2026-10-04',base=head,commit_mode='WORKER_MUST_NOT_COMMIT')
    args.worker_return_profile=profile
    return dispatch.build_worker_return_skeleton(args)
outputs={}
for profile in (standalone.FULL_PROFILE,standalone.FAST_DOC_PROFILE):
    for entry,raw in [('dispatch',build('LOCAL-WRS-73',profile)),('standalone',standalone.build_scaffold('Local independent review',profile))]:
        label=entry+'-'+profile
        outputs[label]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),'retroDeclarations':raw.count(retro.RETRO_TOKEN)+raw.count(retro.RETRO_NA_TOKEN)}
        record(label+'-unfinished-acceptance',ledger.validate_return(wo,raw),False)
        record(label+'-unfinished-retro',retro.diagnose(artifact,raw).issues,False)
        text=completed(raw)
        record(label+'-completed-acceptance',ledger.validate_return(wo,text,{artifact}),True)
        record(label+'-completed-readiness',readiness.diagnose_worker_return(artifact,text).issues,True)
        record(label+'-completed-LOW',retro.diagnose(artifact,text).issues,True)
        na=re.sub(r'WORKER_EXPERIENCE_RETRO:\nfrictionLevel:.*?preventiveControlCandidate:[^\n]*',retro.RETRO_NA_TOKEN+' '+retro.RETRO_NA_REQUIRED_REASON,text,count=1,flags=re.S)
        record(label+'-completed-NA',retro.diagnose(artifact,na).issues,True)
        record(label+'-duplicate-retro',retro.diagnose(artifact,na+'\n'+retro.RETRO_TOKEN+'\n').issues,False)
        record(label+'-wrong-NA',retro.diagnose(artifact,na.replace(retro.RETRO_NA_REQUIRED_REASON,'no observed friction')).issues,False)
        record(label+'-pending-ready',readiness.diagnose_worker_return(artifact,setfield(text,'productionBindingEvidence','PENDING_BEFORE_READY')).issues,False)
        record(label+'-unknown-ready',readiness.diagnose_worker_return(artifact,setfield(text,'terminalReadinessVerdict','READY')).issues,False)
        wrong=text.replace('"actualArtifacts":','"artifacts":')
        record(label+'-wrong-row-keys',ledger.validate_return(wo,wrong),False)
golden=build('WOAS-R3-GOLDEN',standalone.FULL_PROFILE)
ordinary=build('LOCAL-WRS-73',standalone.FULL_PROFILE)
fork={'batchIdOnlyChange':True,'goldenHasEvidenceGuidance':'Evidence completion guidance:' in golden,'ordinaryHasEvidenceGuidance':'Evidence completion guidance:' in ordinary,'goldenRetroIssues':list(retro.diagnose(artifact,golden).issues),'goldenHasOldHyphenPlaceholder':'WORKER_EXPERIENCE_RETRO_NA_WITH_REASON -' in golden,'ordinaryRetroDeclarations':ordinary.count(retro.RETRO_TOKEN)}
assert fork['goldenHasOldHyphenPlaceholder'] and not fork['goldenHasEvidenceGuidance'] and fork['ordinaryHasEvidenceGuidance']
assert all(c['expectationMatched'] for c in cases)
output={'schemaVersion':'cvf.wrsFr1LocalReviewProbe@1','executionBaseHead':head,'disposition':'FINDINGS_CONFIRMED_NOT_ACCEPTED','oracleSeparation':'Direct actual helper output with different literal Local IDs; unchanged consumer calls; no worker test imports or fixture oracle.','caseCount':len(cases),'expectationMatches':sum(c['expectationMatched'] for c in cases),'cases':cases,'outputHashes':outputs,'batchIdFork':fork,'probeSource':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')}
output['probeSourceSha256']=hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
p=root/'docs/reviews/evidence/cvf-wrs-fr1-local-independent-probe-2026-10-04.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(output,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'consumerChecks':len(cases),'expectationMatches':output['expectationMatches'],'batchIdFork':fork,'disposition':output['disposition']}))
